items.title: Wallace Davenport Interview, 1995-11-14
items.q: I think I'd ask you about, we talked about the Doudrop. Did you, and you must have known Frank Panyang.

ctx.x: Well a lot of the older musicians don't like it. But I like it because at least they are playing. And if they play long enough, somebody will get in with them and show them the right way to play, and they'll learn how to read music. And I admire what they're doing.
I think I'd ask you about, we talked about the Doudrop. Did you, and you must have known Frank Panyang.
